crossRefs.note: Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins…
But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are…
“Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within…
You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
(For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of…
They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which…
When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

translations.web: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
translations.bsb: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
translations.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
translations.asv: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.
